dogecoin.text: Just stop mining #Dogecoin and the price will go up.

@070guy roughly 10,000 Dogecoin being mined per minute or around 166.67 DOGE per second. This translates to a total of approximately 5 billion DOGE minted per year. I have the feeling dogecoin will never go past $1. It's being mined too quickly and it's unlimited.
